We’re working to help ensure that every person can build the skills and access the
resources needed to succeed in a digital economy.
Rapid advancement in technology is creating new opportunities in a digital
economy. But these opportunities remain out of reach for many in rural and
remote communities, who often lack the broadband access, resources, or digital
skills required to succeed. We are working to ensure that all people—not just
